laws: H1 is the current evidence-supported FRANK target architecture implemented first in ordinary host code; historical frankv0.1 is evidence/regression lineage, not the architecture template.
H1 implementation may proceed during BASE; H1 PASS remains gated by BASE.
H2 must reproduce frozen H1 semantics in ClayCode; inability to express validated H1 semantics reopens BASE rather than simplifying FRANK.
H3 consolidates proven H1/H2 semantics into one local Clay module/binary and one logical/local UnifiedDB; diagnostic H1/H2 service boundaries do not become final architecture by inertia.
Model, peer, Retina, graph and Needle outputs are proposals/observations, never execution authority.
Adaptive recurrence, provenance-gated binding and emergence metrics remain experiment-swappable until discriminating H1 evidence selects them.
Frank v0.1 release evidence is Ubuntu-only; non-Ubuntu portability is not on the current critical path.

steps.action: Bind deterministic BASE frontend away from obsolete V4 to the then-current V5 candidate.
steps.note: Useful version-drift repair at execution time; later V6/V7 candidate gates advanced the frontier. Do not promote V5 as final merely because this fix landed.

steps.action: Converge V6/V7 strict full-corpus/operator-identity evidence into one production parser/canonical frontend selection, exact grammar identity and deterministic semantic/contract hashing. Update CC-WP-02 only after its stated production receipt requirements are satisfied.
steps.falsifier: Any admitted source or semantic operator mutation aliases to the same canonical identity, or production frontend selects a grammar different from the validated active grammar.

steps.action: Harden the new V7 source -> canonical typed IR -> exact type/symbol check -> reference evaluator -> C11 lowering candidate into a translation-validated pure computational core without pretending effects/FFI/async are closed.
steps.falsifier: Interpreter/C11 differential mismatch, ambiguous typed identity, unsupported core semantics required by frozen BASE, or mutation tests fail to detect semantic changes.

steps.action: Recompute H-WP-01 as a versioned current-target architecture freeze. Preserve compatible old schemas/tests, but remove the old frankv0.1-baseline interpretation from release-oracle status. The refreeze must make ActiveAssembly, peer/backflow, dynamic capability state, Digital Retina/MVC, GWT causal stages, effect authority, recovery/replay and final one-binary mappings explicit.
steps.falsifier: Freeze omits a current owner-fixed invariant or treats a research-only mechanism as selected architecture without a baseline comparison.

steps.action: Complete canonical event/state ledger, epochs, provenance, snapshots, deterministic hashes and replay identity. This is already claimed by another H1 worker and should be consumed, not duplicated.
steps.falsifier: Concurrent/stale updates can silently overwrite state, replay differs without an explicit nondeterminism receipt, or paired-trajectory identity cannot be recovered.

steps.action: Implement one logical semantic state plane with explicit transaction/epoch/replay semantics, derived sparse topology and a bounded task-conditioned ActiveAssembly compiler. Benchmark single-writer contention, snapshot staleness and checkpoint/restart behavior on Ubuntu before deciding physical placement.
steps.falsifier: A multi-store/service design gives materially better correctness/latency/recovery under the same semantic identity contract, or broad prompt-time reconstruction outperforms prepared ActiveAssembly at matched quality/cost.

steps.action: Build explicit GWT stages with per-receiver delivery/reconstruction/uptake/causal-use/outcome/re-entry receipts. Compare ordinary event-driven and fixed-recurrence baselines against the pressure/trend/cost adaptive recurrence candidate; do not let GWT focus itself become the halting oracle.
steps.falsifier: Simpler event-driven/fixed-loop baselines equal or beat adaptive recurrence on verified outcome per compute, tail latency and recovery.

steps.action: Join existing Needle fail-closed proposal validation to opaque capability/resource authority, reserve/commit/outcome/re-entry semantics. Add malformed JSON, duplicate-key, alias collision, unknown/unoffered/blocked tool, tamper, stale capability and retry/idempotency adversarial cases.
steps.falsifier: Any descriptive/model/peer/Needle content can acquire bearer authority or an externally visible effect lacks a verified receipt/recovery boundary.

steps.action: Implement dissolved VisualPercept/PerceptualField semantics plus bounded MVC-0/MVC-1 adaptive learner with GOLD/SILVER/BRONZE provenance, open-set UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS/CONFLICT, shadow promotion, resource budget and last-known-good rollback.
steps.falsifier: Learner familiarity becomes sensor truth/authority, poisoning/open-set tests fail, or resource overhead erases routing benefit.

steps.action: Make observability itself an intervention surface: common-snapshot no/low/high instrumentation arms, paired trajectory identity, trace completeness and explicit timing/resource perturbation receipts.
steps.falsifier: Instrumentation causes paired semantic/action flips beyond preregistered tolerance or hides unobserved causal paths.

steps.action: Use deterministic model fixtures now; later benchmark the chosen Qwen-class 4B quantization/backend on Andreas' Ubuntu host for latency, RAM/KV, long-context degradation, ActiveAssembly size, tool-intent quality and peer-escalation rate.
steps.falsifier: Target 4B cannot meet frozen latency/memory/outcome envelope or another local model/quantization dominates under the same architecture.

steps.action: Reimplement frozen H1 semantics in ClayCode and run translated state/input/intervention Golden Traces. Classify every divergence as H2 bug, H1 bug, ambiguous contract, ClayCode expressibility gap or intentional versioned divergence.
steps.falsifier: Unexplained divergence remains or ClayCode needs a semantic escape hatch.

steps.action: Collapse diagnostic module/service boundaries into one Clay runtime/binary where evidence allows, retain one local UnifiedDB semantic world, local 4B, transient/derived topology and explicit security/resource boundaries. Remove a boundary only when H1/H2 semantic/recovery/performance receipts survive.
steps.falsifier: Consolidation causes unacceptable fault containment, tail latency, recovery or authority regressions versus H1/H2.

non_promotions: No adaptive recurrence promotion from synthetic proxy evidence.
No RAB/provenance lattice promotion from synthetic reversal tests.
No phenomenal-consciousness inference from GWT/emergence behavior.
No ClayCode package PASS solely from candidate/CI definitions.
No H1 credit from the invalidated old freeze until a current-target refreeze exists.
No non-Ubuntu v0.1 portability work on the critical path.
